review_candidates.title: Planning & Scheduling Manager
review_candidates.description: Overview AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Planning & Scheduling Manager, in Riyadh, KSA. The Planning & Scheduling Manager will be responsible for leading all planning, scheduling, progress monitoring, and reporting activities across major roads, highways, bridges, interchanges, and transportation infrastructure projects within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment. The role will ensure effective development and management of integrated project schedules, monitor project performance, identify schedule risks and recovery opportunities, and provide strategic planning support to project and client leadership teams. The Planning & Scheduling Manager will play a key role in driving schedule certainty and supporting successful project delivery within approved timelines. Your role Planning & Scheduling Lead the development, maintenance, and management of master program schedules for large-scale infrastructure projects. Establish planning procedures, scheduling standards, and project controls processes in line with client and PMC requirements. Develop and review baseline schedules for design, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning phases. Ensure project schedules are fully integrated across all disciplines and stakeholders. Validate contractor schedules and ensure compliance with contractual requirements. Monitor schedule performance and baseline adherence throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and maintain work breakdown structures (WBS), project coding structures, and scheduling methodologies. Schedule Control & Performance Monitoring Analyze project progress and identify critical path activities. Monitor schedule variances and recommend corrective actions. Assess project performance using key performance indicators (KPIs). Lead recovery planning workshops and develop mitigation plans for schedule delays. Evaluate contractor recovery schedules and acceleration proposals. Ensure schedule updates are accurate, timely, and aligned with site progress. Collaborate with cost control, risk management, engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure schedule alignment. Support forecasting and project performance reporting. Integrate planning activities with project controls processes and reporting requirements. Participate in change management assessments and evaluate schedule impacts arising from design changes, variations, and claims. Schedule Risk Analysis Lead Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA) activities for major infrastructure projects. Conduct critical path assessments and schedule health checks. Perform quantitative schedule analyses using Monte Carlo simulations. Develop schedule confidence assessments (P50, P80, P90). Identify schedule risk drivers and recommend mitigation measures. Support contingency planning and informed decision-making through risk-based scheduling. Reporting & Stakeholder Management Prepare executive dashboards, look-ahead programs, schedule analysis reports, and progress presentations. Present project schedule status and key risks to senior management and client representatives. Facilitate planning meetings, progress review sessions, and schedule coordination workshops. Interface with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities regarding schedule performance and delivery strategies. Provide strategic planning advice to Project Directors and Program Directors. About You Minimum 20 years of experience in planning and scheduling for major infrastructure projects. Minimum 8 years of experience in a Planning Manager or Scheduling Manager capacity. Proven experience working within a PMC, engineering consultancy, or major infrastructure organization. Demonstrated experience on large-scale roads, highways, bridges, interchanges, tunnels, and transportation infrastructure projects. Experience working with government authorities and major transportation agencies in the Middle East is highly desirable. Strong understanding of project lifecycle planning from concept design through construction and handover. Advanced proficiency in: Primavera P6, Primavera Risk Analysis, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Advanced Microsoft Excel Rewards & Benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. This Includes Tax-free salary. Comprehensive life insurance coverage. Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents. Generous annual leave balance. Flexible and hybrid work solutions. Remote work opportunities outside of country. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Annual flight contribution. Relocation assistance. Transportation & housing allowances (available for remote work locations). Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. About AtkinsRéalis We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people. Find out more. #RBP

Who are we? ALEC Holdings PJSC, part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading GCC construction group with over two decades of success delivering some of the region’s most complex and high-profile projects. As a proudly publicly listed company, ALEC continues to raise the bar for quality, innovation, and excellence in construction, driving iconic developments that shape skylines across the Middle East. In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions. ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success. Why Join Us? As a Digital Construction Coordinator in ALEC Building, you’ll be at the heart of delivering iconic structures. Our team shapes landmark projects from foundation to finish - providing the space and support for you to take ownership, lead boldly, and build excellence into every detail. At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Digital Construction initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences. About Your Team The Digital Construction team plays a key role in enabling project success through effective BIM implementation, model coordination, and information management. We foster a collaborative environment where innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence help deliver smarter and more connected construction projects. Your Role As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you will Support the communication and delivery of project information requirements internally and externally. Assist in ensuring client exchange information requirements are met and properly documented. Contribute to the development and upkeep of information management resources, including execution plans, responsibility matrices, and delivery schedules. Help monitor and maintain the project’s Common Data Environment (CDE) and electronic document management systems (EDMS). Support the setup and management of BIM workflows from contract award through to handover of deliverables. Undertake 3D spatial coordination using BIM software, reporting clashes and issues to project stakeholders. Provide training and day-to-day support on BIM processes, use cases, and digital tools to project teams. Carry out QA/QC checks on BIM models and information deliverables from internal teams and subcontractors. Contribute to project-level reporting, tender support, and the continuous improvement of digital construction processes. Apply technical expertise and discipline-specific knowledge to deliver high-quality outcomes within your area of specialisation. Undertake any other reasonable duties and/or responsibilities as required by management, to meet the needs of the business. What We’re Looking For Skills and Competencies Knowledge of ISO 19650 & Information Management (IM) processes. Proficiency with BIM authoring tools (Revit, Tekla, Archicad) & coordination software (Navisworks, Revizto). Understanding of openBIM standards such as Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) & Construction Operations Building Information Exchange (COBie). Experience with cloud-based CDE platforms (Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud Docs). Detail-oriented with strong organisational & problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Strong communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across disciplines. Exposure to automated model checking & data validation tools (e.g., Solibri). Familiarity with visual programming (Python, Dynamo) and 4D/5D BIM processes. Experience with data management & reporting platforms (Microsoft Power BI). Analytical, resilient, & adaptable with a positive, collaborative mindset. Willingness to learn & develop professionally. Qualifications & Experience Degree in appropriate discipline or equivalent demonstrated experience and/or 5+ years experience What We Offer The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Ready to lead the digital transformation of construction project delivery? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Join ALEC Building and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success. Apply today and be part of something excellent! Please note we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as this advert may close once we’ve found the right candidate. Although we can’t respond to every application, we want to thank you for taking the time to apply and for considering a future with us.

Content Creation & Social Media Management (Main Responsibility) Plan and execute diverse content ideas for COBI Home Shopping Mall, COBI ACTIVE SPORT HUB, and other business divisions Plan, produce, and manage content across Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant channels Produce short-form content including Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, social posts, promotional videos, event content, and lifestyle content Develop content concepts, scripts, storyboards, captions, and creative direction aligned with campaign objectives Create content tailored to each brand's positioning, target audience, and communication direction Continuously monitor the latest social media trends, viral content formats, trending audio, content styles, and digital trends Adapt current trends to fit COBI's brand identity and business characteristics Ensure all content maintains consistent brand identity, tone of voice, visual quality, and key messaging 2. Video Filming & Editing Independently plan and execute video shoots for social media, marketing campaigns, events, property/facility introductions, and promotions Operate cameras, smartphones, lighting, microphones, gimbals, and other basic filming equipment Film high-quality video content with attention to composition, lighting, framing, and storytelling Edit short-form and long-form videos suited to various digital platforms Enhance content quality using music, subtitles, transitions, sound effects, graphics, and other visual elements Produce content quickly in response to events, promotions, and real-time social media trends Systematically manage raw footage, filming materials, project files, and the content library Collaborate with external videographers, photographers, designers, influencers, and production vendors as needed 3. Content Planning & Marketing Campaign Support Support the development of monthly and campaign-specific content calendars Collaborate with the Marketing team to translate marketing goals into creative content ideas Produce content related to new property/facility launches, promotions, events, tenant activities, sports programs, co-working services, and other business activities Support the creation of campaign content for online and offline marketing channels Collaborate with Marketing, Leasing, Operations, and other relevant departments to gather information and develop suitable content Actively participate in brainstorming sessions and propose new content ideas and creative concepts Ensure content is produced and published according to schedule and campaign objectives 4. AI & Digital Content Innovation Use AI tools to enhance content planning, ideation, research, scriptwriting, editing, image generation, video production, and overall work efficiency Actively apply AI-based tools for content generation, visual development, AI voiceovers, subtitles, animation, and post-production Continuously explore new technologies and digital tools to improve content quality and production speed Build efficient AI-driven content production processes while maintaining brand consistency and content quality Continuously learn and apply the latest AI and content production technologies to actual work Share useful AI tools, techniques, and best practices with the Marketing team 5. Creative Development & Brand Storytelling Develop creative concepts and storytelling approaches that make the COBI brand more engaging and memorable Produce content that effectively communicates the lifestyle, experience, benefits, and differentiated strengths of COBI's properties, facilities, and services Develop content series and recurring formats that boost customer engagement and brand awareness Identify opportunities for User-Generated Content (UGC), influencer content, customer stories, and community-based content Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and the overall marketing strategy Propose new creative ideas to enhance brand awareness and customer engagement 6. Event & On-Site Content Support Support content production at company events, sports competitions, exhibitions, community activities, tenant events, and promotional programs Capture photos and videos on-site for real-time social media posting and post-event content production Produce behind-the-scenes footage, highlights, event recaps, interviews, and promotional content Collaborate with the Event and Marketing teams to effectively capture key moments and content opportunities Produce timely event recap videos and social media content after events conclude 7. Content Performance Analysis & Optimization Continuously monitor the performance of content published across social media channels Analyze views, reach, engagement rate, watch time, follower growth, click-through rate, and other relevant KPIs Analyze content performance to identify effective content formats, topics, and creative elements Recommend content improvements based on performance data and audience behavior Continuously test new content formats, hooks, storytelling approaches, and creative methods to improve engagement and reach 8. Cross-Department Collaboration & Special Projects Work closely with Marketing, Leasing, Operations, and other relevant departments, using content to support business goal achievement Collaborate with external partners, influencers, KOLs/KOCs, photographers, videographers, and creative agencies as needed Support special marketing projects and new business initiatives as assigned by management Take ownership of assigned content projects end-to-end — from planning and filming to production, editing, and final delivery Perform other marketing- and creative-related duties as required Requirements review_candidates.title: Business Support Executive - Trilingual
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are looking for a highly capable Trilingual Business Support Executive to support our Indonesia market. This role plays a critical part in facilitating communication, documentation, and operational coordination across internal teams, customers, and regional stakeholders in Indonesia, Malaysia, and China. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, Bahasa Indonesia, and Mandarin, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a cross-cultural, regional environment. Key Responsibilities Translation & Interpretation Translate business documents, presentations, emails, and reports between Mandarin, English, and Bahasa Indonesia Provide real-time interpretation during meetings, calls, and discussions with internal teams, partners, and customers Ensure accuracy, clarity, and cultural appropriateness in all communications Operational & Business Support Support daily operations related to marketing, business development, and customer service Assist in coordinating activities and communications between Indonesia and overseas teams (Malaysia & China) Prepare meeting summaries, action items, and follow-ups in multiple languages Support onboarding and communication with Indonesia-based customers or partners Office administration, including leave and attendance tracking, reporting, and records management Cross-Functional Coordination Act as a communication bridge between regional stakeholders Assist in tracking operational progress, timelines, and deliverables Handle ad-hoc operational tasks as required to support business growth in Indonesia Requirements Fluent in English, Bahasa Indonesia, and Mandarin (HSK Level 5, 6 or equivalent proficiency in written and spoken Mandarin is required) Strong verbal and written communication skills Experience in translation, operations, customer support, or regional coordination is an advantage Ability to work with stakeholders across different cultures and time zones Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to handle confidential information Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment What We Offer Exposure to regional and cross-border operations (Indonesia, Malaysia, China) Opportunity to work closely with overseas colleagues and senior stakeholders Career development opportunities in operations, regional coordination, or business support functions Competitive compensation based on experience and language proficiency

review_candidates.title: Business Development Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Niche Magazine Middle East is a premier luxury and lifestyle publication, catering to a sophisticated audience with a passion for high-end fashion, travel, and culture. As a leading voice in the industry, we deliver engaging and inspiring content that reflects the elegance and vibrancy of the Middle East. With a strong presence in the region, our magazine connects readers with exclusive brands and experiences. Role Description We are looking for a full-time, on-site Business Development Specialist to join our team in Qesm El Maadi. This role involves identifying and cultivating new business opportunities, nurturing client relationships, and conducting thorough market research to understand industry trends. The specialist will be responsible for lead generation, identifying partnership opportunities, and contributing to revenue growth, all while maintaining excellent customer service and communication standards. The role is sales-focused and requires achieving monthly and quarterly sales. Qualifications Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills that support building and maintaining relationships. Proficiency in lead generation and the ability to identify potential business opportunities. Analytical skills and market research experience for analyzing trends and building effective sales strategies. Customer service expertise to provide exceptional support and build trust with clients. Proactive, self-motivated, and results-driven with effective time-management abilities. Experience in the luxury or lifestyle industry is an added advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field preferred.

review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description: Business Development Manager – Tomohi Digital Education Platform   CIS Group is looking for an experienced, ambitious, and results-driven Business Development Manager to lead the growth and commercial development of Tomohi, our digital education platform.   This is a key role combining Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Digital Platform Management, with a strong focus on growing the platform, expanding its market presence, increasing learner acquisition, and generating sustainable revenue.   About the Role :   The Business Development Manager will take ownership of Tomohi’s business growth by identifying new opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, driving sales and marketing activities, and ensuring the platform continues to meet the needs of learners and business clients. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working in a digital and fast-paced environment.   Key Responsibilities : Business Development & Growth   Develop and implement business development strategies to grow Tomohi and expand its market presence. Identify new markets, customer segments, business opportunities, and potential revenue streams. Research market trends, competitors, and customer needs within the digital education and e-learning sector. Develop new business opportunities across B2B, B2C, corporate, and institutional markets. Build and maintain strategic partnerships with companies, educational institutions, organizations, and other relevant stakeholders. Prepare business proposals and commercial offers and present them to potential partners and clients.   Sales & Revenue   Lead the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to pitching, negotiation, closing, and follow-up. Develop sales strategies to achieve agreed enrollment and revenue targets. Identify and convert prospective learners, companies, and institutional clients. Maintain and develop a strong sales pipeline. Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, revenue, and acquisition results. Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, repeat enrollment, and long-term customer relationships.   Marketing & Digital Growth   Develop and coordinate marketing initiatives to increase Tomohi’s visibility, reach, and learner acquisition. Work closely with marketing resources on social media, digital campaigns, email marketing, promotions, and lead-generation activities. Identify new channels and opportunities to attract qualified leads. Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements. Ensure consistent communication of Tomohi’s brand, mission, and value proposition. Monitor market and competitor activities and provide recommendations for positioning and growth.   Digital Platform Management   Manage the business and operational aspects of the Tomohi digital education platform. Monitor registrations, enrollments, platform usage, learner engagement, and course completion. Coordinate with IT and technical teams to ensure smooth platform operations. Identify platform issues, improvements, and new features that can enhance the user experience and business performance. Coordinate the launch of new courses, programs, services, and platform initiatives. Monitor the learner journey from registration and onboarding through course completion.   Learner Experience & Retention   Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new learners. Monitor learner engagement and identify opportunities to improve retention and completion. Collect learner feedback and use insights to improve the platform and services. Address learner concerns and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution. Develop initiatives that encourage learner satisfaction, referrals, repeat enrollment, and long-term engagement.   Performance & Reporting   Establish and monitor KPIs related to sales, revenue, marketing, learner acquisition, engagement, retention, and platform performance. Analyze business and platform data and identify areas for improvement. Prepare regular performance reports and recommendations for senior management. Track performance against approved business and revenue targets.   Qualifications :   Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Business, Communications, Education, or a related field. 5–7 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, marketing, digital platforms, e-learning, or a related field. Experience in the education, training, or digital learning sector is highly preferred. Proven experience in sales, business development, partnerships, and revenue generation. Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition. Experience working with digital platforms, CRM systems, and online customer journeys. Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent English and Arabic communication skills; French is a plus. Ability to work cross-functionally with Marketing, IT, Academic, Operations, and Management teams. Highly proactive, organized, results-oriented, and capable of taking ownership of projects and targets.
